breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: both Neumann (∂u/∂n = 0) and Dirichlet (u = 0). The ground truth resolved this by keeping only the Neumann condition. The agent correctly identified and fixed this by only including the Neumann condition in the generated specification: 'Zero Neumann boundary conditions (∂u/∂n = 0) are applied on all boundary edges.'
